user.title: Connect to flicd
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running the flicd daemon. To accept connections from other machines, flicd must be started with `-s 0.0.0.0`.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the flicd server.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to flicd. Check the host and port, and that flicd was started with `-s 0.0.0.0` if it runs on another machine.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This flicd server is already configured. Its host and port have been updated.

data_description.queue_timeout: Clicks queued while Home Assistant was disconnected and older than this are dropped. 0 drops all queued clicks.
data_description.ignored_click_types: Click types that do not fire events.
data_description.auto_pair: Keep flicd's pairing wizard running so any button held for 7 seconds is paired. Disables pairing from this dialog.

progress.pairing: Press and hold the Flic button for 7 seconds until it blinks. Pairing needs internet access on the flicd host.

abort.auto_pair_enabled: Automatic pairing is enabled. Disable it in the settings to pair from this dialog.
abort.pair_timeout: No button was found in time.
abort.pair_private: The button is in private mode. Hold it for 7 seconds first to make it public.
abort.pair_bluetooth_unavailable: The Bluetooth controller of the flicd host is unavailable.
abort.pair_backend_error: The Flic internet backend returned an error. Check the internet access of the flicd host.
abort.pair_other_partner: The button belongs to another partner and cannot be paired.
abort.pair_connected_elsewhere: The button is connected to another device. Disconnect it there first.
